_comment: How the OnPay import file is built. OnPay switched CSV upload on for this account on 4 Sep 2026 and sent the specification these values come from. The file is one row per PAY ITEM, not one row per person, and the pay types are numbers.
_the_columns: type, id, emp_num, hours, rate, treat_as_cash, cash_amount, ob3_qualified_ot. type is always 1. emp_num is the Clock User from the employee's OnPay profile (Job tab > Employment > Clock User). OnPay confirmed this on 8 September 2026: Employee Number is optional and Clock User is required. There is no bulk import for Clock Users - each is typed into that person's profile by hand, so the app picks the numbers and holds them (Roster > Clock Users).
_the_one_rule_that_shapes_everything: OnPay allows only ONE row for pay item 1 and ONE for pay item 2 per employee. A caregiver who worked two different rates in a week therefore cannot have both on pay item 1, which is why a second hourly pay type is used for the higher tier.
_how_overtime_is_written: All paid hours stay on their hourly rate tiers. Overtime Premium (17) and Double Time Premium (121) carry only the calculated premium cash amounts, with treat_as_cash=1 and blank hours/rate. Both custom items must be Non-Hourly in OnPay. Items 2 and 22 are unused because OnPay recalculates them.

pay_ids._premium_note: Use Non-Hourly custom items: Overtime Premium is 17 (Custom 2); Double Time Premium is 121 (Custom 5). Item 4 is Prior Pay Adjustment and must not be repurposed. The premium items were verified as Non-Hourly in OnPay on 16 September 2026.

tier_pay_ids._comment: Which OnPay pay item carries each Sitterwise rate tier. These are OnPay's internal pay-item IDs, which are NOT the numbers in the 'Custom N' names - 'Custom 1' is id 4, 'Custom 4' is id 119. Check the id, not the name. 'standard' must be 1, and no two tiers may share an id or OnPay will reject the file.
tier_pay_ids._three_to_four_note: 3-4 Children is the Hourly custom pay item 119 (Custom 4). Keep it Hourly; only the separate premium items are Non-Hourly.
tier_pay_ids._unknown_note: Safety net only: jobs with an unresolved rate are blocked and excluded from the upload. Custom 3 (118) stays separate from both premium items.

_confirmed_with_onpay.ob3_qualified_ot: All overtime hours - confirmed by Amy, 4 Sep 2026.
_confirmed_with_onpay.reimbursement_107: Excluded from taxable wages on this account - confirmed 4 Sep 2026.
_confirmed_with_onpay.tips: 208 Controlled Tips, not 108 Cash Tips - confirmed 4 Sep 2026.
_confirmed_with_onpay.salary: Pay item 1 with a cash amount and no hours or rate, as in OnPay's own template.

pay_item_names._comment: What each pay item is called in OnPay, so the app can name the line on screen. Change these if you rename a pay item.

_ob3_open_question: OPEN, to ask OnPay support: the premium now sits on a custom pay item, so OnPay's OBBB Qualified OT column is not being filled in by OnPay's own overtime engine. The file still sends the hours in the ob3 column. Nobody has confirmed whether OnPay reads it from a custom item.
